types.name: ComponentAddition
docs: A component appended to a fixed-weight basket by a composition change.

types.name: CompositionChange
docs: An announced change to a fixed-weight basket's target weights and/or components.
It can only be applied COMPOSITION_CHANGE_DELAY_SECONDS after it was proposed, so
holders see it coming and can redeem first. Setting a weight to zero removes a
component: the next rebalance sells it and it then sits empty in its slot.

fields.name: redeem_fee_bps
docs: Total redeem fee when proposed. Applying requires redemptions to be open at no more
than this, so the notice period is a real chance to exit.

fields.name: target_weights_bps
docs: New target weight for each existing component, in global component order.

fields.name: additions
docs: Components to append after the existing ones, in this order.

types.name: CompositionChangeDelayed
docs: Redemptions were paused or unpaused, or the redeem fee changed, while a change was
pending: its notice restarts from now.

fields.name: in_kind
docs: Deposit the exact component tokens in-kind instead of swapping USDC -> components.

fields.name: in_kind
docs: Withdraw the exact component tokens in-kind instead of swapping components -> USDC.

fields.name: target_weights_bps
docs: New target weight for each existing component, in global component order.

fields.name: quote_limit
docs: Sell leg: minimum USDC to receive. Buy leg: maximum USDC to spend.

types.name: RebalanceIntent
docs: Index-scoped, in-flight rebalance. Only one can be active per index at a time
(tracked by `IndexState.active_rebalance_intent` + `operation_in_progress`, which
also mutually-excludes mint/redeem). Mirrors the large-basket mint/redeem intent
machinery but rebalance-shaped: targets + sell/buy progress instead of one fill set.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Pubkey::default() removes the keeper, leaving rebalances to the authority.
